title: LPV vs LNAV: The Minima Lines
hook: Four lines of minimums on one RNAV plate. Which one is yours?

scenes.narration: You load the R NAV one-six, and the plate stacks up four lines of minimums like a wine list. The box annunciates L P V. Alright kid — which line did you just earn?
The box says L P V. Do you fly a decision altitude, or level off at an M D A? Commit.
A decision altitude — as low as two hundred feet. L P V is WAAS giving you I L S-style angular guidance with no ground station, no towers. Just math with a God complex.
Down the stack: L NAV V NAV — still a D A, with approved vertical guidance. Plain L NAV — lateral only, step down to an M D A like it's nineteen seventy-five.

Why must you check the annunciator by the final fix? Because WAAS integrity is decided in real time — the box only promises what the signal can guarantee RIGHT NOW. Fly the line it gives you, not the line you hoped for.
onScreenText: Fly what the box GIVES you

scenes.narration: Eyes off the screen. Which lines come with a D A, and which one is dive-and-drive? Out loud.
L P V like an I L S. L NAV V NAV, a D A with a glidepath. Plain L NAV, level at the M D A. Your G P S went to school for this — read its report card.
From the V O R lesson — radials point which direction from the station? Quick.
A I M one dash one dash eighteen. WAAS, explained by people paid by the hour.

quiz.question: Your GPS annunciates LPV on the RNAV 16. You fly it to:
choices: A decision altitude — like an ILS
An MDA — level until the missed point
The LNAV line, to be safe
quiz.explanation: LPV (Localizer Performance with Vertical guidance) uses WAAS angular guidance and a DA as low as 200 ft. (AIM 1-1-18)

quiz.question: Flying to plain LNAV minimums, you descend to...
choices: An MDA — level off until the missed point or runway in sight
A DA — decide as you reach it
quiz.explanation: LNAV is lateral-only; its minimum is an MDA you must not descend below without the runway environment. (91.175)

quiz.question: Your GPS annunciates "LNAV" on an approach you briefed for LPV. You should:
choices: Ask ATC to fix your WAAS signal
quiz.explanation: The annunciated service level determines your line of minima — fly what the box is actually providing.
